note: Both sets extract the same 19–20 table values with essentially identical errors: each binds every R-57.5 row value (17,080; 14,880; 2,423; 459; 2,882; 19,802; 15,852; 2,870; 3,920) to a 'roof insulation R-47.5' condition, and each mislabels the BEoptE+ Loads values (17,320; 15,000; 17,080; 14,880 Btu/hr) as 'energy use' rather than heating/cooling load. Set A and Set B are otherwise equivalent in value/condition binding (e.g., 2,476/466/2,942 kWh and 2890/1,050/3,940 kWh correctly tied to R-47.5), with only wording differences ('column 2/3' vs 'first/second value'). Set B adds one trivial R-value claim (47.5 R) with a questionable 'BEoptE+ analysis' condition, while both omit the 2.08% and 0.51% annual energy increase results and never distinguish the R-57.5 case. Net effect is a tie.
